Name: Custom Hot Springs Regeneration Rate
Author: Teoshen
Description:
Do you like the feeling of a hot bath after a long day of work, but worry about the balance of having such amenities so close to home?

Or, do you really hate being short on energy and want to take quick, refreshing dips that refill your stamina in seconds to chop more trees?

In either case, this mod allows you to adjust the stamina and health regeneration rate in the farm cave hot springs, from 10% to 200%.



Technical stuff: 
[spoiler]This does not transpile the base game's code, but rather adds a second counter to the base game's logic of adding one stamina/health every 100ms. Based on the config setting, it will create a counter of X ms and run against that, adding or subtracting a stamina/health per X ms. As such, seeing energy 'wiggle' a bit is not unexpected, though with the 1.1 update it should be pretty smooth overall. Also the config options will run on each machine differently, despite my best efforts to handle mismatched tick rates. As far as I can tell, the base game will 'clip' excess ms each time the counter is met, my mod tries to track those extra ms to smooth out how it is adding or subtracting. A slower machine will have more ms in each tick, making the base game potentially add fewer stamina/health per second, and will make my mod feel a little more jittery.The short of it is don't rely on the % amount completely, tweak it until it 'feels right'.[/spoiler]
